name: openrouter-pdf-translator
description: Translate PDFs in Obsidian via OpenRouter and other LLM providers (standard Obsidian esbuild build, bundled pdf.js, no CDN)

scripts.build: node scripts/patch-pdfjs.mjs && node esbuild.mjs production && node scripts/verify-bundle.mjs
scripts.test: node scripts/patch-pdfjs.mjs && node build-runtime-tests.mjs && node test-runtime-bundle.cjs && node test-e2e-bundle.cjs
scripts.version: node version-bump.mjs && git add manifest.json versions.json
